scenario_description:
Objective: Have the spring heat-pump tune-up include its planned filter replacement rather than only an inspection.
Emerging Need: A compatible unopened filter must be on site for the vendor, and shared storage later shows no spare remains.
Decision Context: Stored appliance notes identify the exact compatible filter, while household guidance says to wait for vendor confirmation and meet the local-order cutoff.
Consequence: Missing the supplier cutoff leaves the prerequisite unavailable before the appointment, so the tune-up can no longer deliver the replacement benefit.

parameter.title: Spring heat-pump tune-up
parameter.description: Cascadia Home Comfort seasonal service visit for the townhouse heat pump.

parameter.subject: Friday tune-up supply note
parameter.body: For Friday's heat-pump tune-up, the technician can replace the return filter only if an unopened compatible filter is already on site. If no filter is available, the appointment will still proceed, but the replacement line item will be skipped.

parameter.content: I checked the hall closet shelf after dinner. There aren't any sealed heat-pump filters left there; I used the last one during the February dust cleanup.

parameter.name: Division Hardware Special Orders
parameter.notes: Phone reservations for HVAC filters can be held unpaid until 13:00 for next-morning pickup; after cutoff, nonstock sizes arrive the next business day. Confirmed Friday pickups are available 08:00–08:30; the counter is a ten-minute walk from the townhouse.

parameter.subject: HVAC filter pickup cutoff update
parameter.body: Today's 13:00 reservation cutoff has passed. New special-order HVAC filter requests placed this afternoon will be available Monday, April 13, rather than Friday morning pickup.
